invariant: Evidence report for one provider and exact provider revision.
mustPreserve: Risk adoption cannot close a gap or occur after closure; each review binds same provider/current report.
identityReadingRule: selectedIdentitySummary and exact selectedCommandContracts define intended identity. baselineIdentityObservation/declaredIdentity retain older source observations only, including old replay defects; they are not target behavior or authorization to change an occupied key.

logicalIdentity.rule: caller-supplied immutable creation identity: an exact retry with the same id and authored intent returns the original result; the same id with changed intent is refused; a different id is a different record
CommandId binds one immutable authored intent to the exact owner identity and expected revision: an exact retry returns the original result, a changed intent under the same CommandId is refused
deterministic receiver identity derived from the admitted root fact, episode and generation; exact redelivery resolves the original result

selectedCommandContracts.guard: Exact parent admitted intent and complete source selection; current source revision/required immutable facts; active use prevents conflicting source writes through parent decision append. Use events do not advance public ResourceRevision; the exact content-event identity and metadata owner version remain separate.
selectedCommandContracts.failure: Exact replay returns original result; proven superseded operation is terminal no-op; unavailable dependency/unknown append is transient; changed intent or invalid proof is permanent conflict/quarantine.

logicalIdentity.rule: deterministic receiver identity derived from the admitted root fact, episode and generation; exact redelivery resolves the original result

selectedCommandContracts.guard: Exact terminal parent decision or receiver-fenced cancellation proof; settle only the matching operation/generation, never release because of time/missing read. A canceled parent fences local completion; record terminal source-use settlement even when acquire has not yet arrived, so delayed acquisition cannot recreate authority. Derive Disposition from the proven terminal source: parent_closed installs its generation closure fence, canceled clears only this use after parent fence, irreversible_decision releases the pinned source after historical decision. Never clear a use into an unrestricted writable child after parent closure.
selectedCommandContracts.failure: Exact replay returns original result; proven superseded operation is terminal no-op; unavailable dependency/unknown append is transient; changed intent or invalid proof is permanent conflict/quarantine.

identityContractRule: Existing published owner identity/IdFor remains stable. Required typed creation/operation identity and tenant/program/source scope come from the selected signature/protocol references; no context.RequestId minting fallback or guessed new stream key.
selectedIdentitySummary: Tenant-scoped (tenantId, providerId, reportId); `ReportId` on `RecordAssuranceReport` is the caller-supplied immutable creation identity (exact immutable creation retry) so an exact retry resolves the original result and a different id is a different record; later mutations use CommandId bound to this identity and the expected revision.
selectedReplayRule: Current required authorization precedes replay; exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result using the selected logical identity and immutable actor/intent/source binding. Fresh mutable feasibility, clock selection and body preparation cannot replace that original result. Expected revision is concurrency precondition, not a new identity.

productRules.rule: An assurance report records kind, period or point-in-time date, issuing firm, opinion (unqualified, qualified, adverse, disclaimer), covered services, exceptions, relevant CUECs, coverage gaps, bridge letter when the report period ends before the need, and a governed artifact reference.

decides: A report records kind (soc2_type1, soc2_type2, iso27001, questionnaire), period or point-in-time date, issuing firm, opinion (unqualified, qualified, adverse, disclaimer), covered services, exceptions, CUECs, coverage gaps, a bridge letter when the report period ends before the need, and a governed artifact reference.
